touched.task_desc: 1.1 Run `sdd sync` from the repository root so the SDD block is written into CLAUDE.md; `.claude/settings.json` is already committed, and `sdd/changes/settings-canonical-first/` is staged with CLAUDE.md ("sdd is committed in the fork").

2.1 In tests/unit/shared-manager.test.ts, inside the `diverged settings adoption` block, move each test that checks the newer-wins copy-in mechanics and uses settings.json only as the example file onto `installed_plugins.json` at an account's plugins path, keeping what it asserts: `preserves diverged bytes when canonical backup creation fails`, `does not let a stale Windows fallback roll back newer canonical settings`, `preserves divergence when the canonical settings symlink is dangling`, `preserves malformed managed JSON instead of poisoning canonical settings`, `aborts relinking when a writer replaces the path after it is claimed`, `refuses to publish when the canonical file changes before publication`, `keeps adopted bytes recoverable when canonical changes after verification`, `fails reconciliation when the managed source reappears during late cleanup`, `retries backup publication without replacing a concurrent backup`, `preserves regular and symlink-target modes under a restrictive umask`, `publishes with the mode the canonical inode carries at publication time`. Rename a test only where its title names settings.
3.1 In src/management/shared-manager/types.ts, set the settings.json shared item's divergence policy to `canonical-first` ("settings.json is canonical-first").
